calls.head: Don’t count on Vasilevskiy to stand on his head again
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Vasilevskiy has been a wall against the Flyers, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Expect the usual Vasilevskiy.
calls.call: If Vasilevskiy starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .910 than to his .944 against the Flyers.
calls.nums: 7 starts against Philadelphia: .944 save percentage · .910 against everyone else
calls.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 7 against Philadelphia, 4,532 shots against everyone else
calls.happened: A. Vasilevskiy stopped 14 of 15 shots (.933), against his usual .910 and his .944 against this team before tonight.

calls.head: Expect the Lightning to fire from everywhere
calls.body: Philadelphia has been giving up shots all season, and the Lightning rarely pass one up.
calls.call: The Lightning take at least their usual 60.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
calls.nums: Tampa Bay 6th for shot volume (60.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Philadelphia 28th for shot suppression
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: Tampa Bay took 77.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against their usual 60.3.

TBL.head: We gave Tampa Bay a 61% chance, and Tampa Bay delivered.

PHI.head: We gave Philadelphia only a 39% chance, and it went the way we feared.

surprises.head: Philadelphia tried a different line
surprises.body: C. Grundstrom, N. Acciari, S. Couturier played 8:36 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Philadelphia’s usual lines.

surprises.head: Tampa Bay hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Tampa Bay’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 67, against their usual 105 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 10 games.

story.head: The Lightning beat the Flyers
paras: Brayden Point opened the scoring late in the first. Four different Lightning scored.

The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Lightning win nine in ten. By our Swing measure, Nikita Kucherov had the best night of anyone. The Flyers tried a line they hadn’t used before: Carl Grundstrom, Noel Acciari and Sean Couturier.
